source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: As mentioned above, the examples in (36c), (37c) and (39c) are not ungrammatical: it is the intended proper reflexive meaning which makes them ill-formed. As shown below, assigning them a different meaning makes them well-formed.
en: Kesha pampered himself.. But: Kesha fathered a child.
